Modify, Insert, or Delete DICOM Header Tags

Source: R/tags.R
dicom_modify.Rd

Updates, inserts, or deletes specified tags in a DICOM file using the native C++ engine and writes the modified dataset to out_path.

Usage

dicom_modify(
  path,
  tags = list(),
  out_path = path,
  delete_tags = character(),
  erase_private = FALSE,
  regenerate_uids = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Input DICOM file path.

tags

Named list or named character vector of tags (by "(GGGG,EEEE)" or keyword such as "PatientName") and their new string values.

out_path

Output DICOM file path. Defaults to modifying path in-place.

delete_tags

Character vector of tags or keywords to remove.

erase_private

Logical. Remove all odd-group private tags. Default is FALSE.

regenerate_uids

Logical. Generate fresh SOPInstanceUID, StudyInstanceUID, and SeriesInstanceUID. Default is FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns out_path.

Examples

dcm_file <- system.file("extdata", "example.dcm", package = "dicomtk")
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".dcm")
dicom_modify(dcm_file, tags = list(PatientName = "ANON^PATIENT"), out_path = tmp)
dicom_tag_value(tmp, "PatientName")
#>    PatientName 
#> "ANON^PATIENT"
